transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our surge huddle started. As we all know, we're currently running near capacity with 10 of 12 treatment spaces occupied, and we're monitoring a regional increase in pediatric respiratory illness that's expected to drive higher ED demand tomorrow. The good news is we have an unused observation wing with eight bays available for temporary clinical use. Under our surge policy, we need to accommodate all six forecasted monitored-observation patients simultaneously in the observation wing during the 07:00 to 13:00 window, and the main ED can't hold monitored-observation overflow during that time. So we need to activate at least six bays and agree on the staffing plan. Let's hear from nursing staffing, facilities, and bed management on what it will take to operationalize this by tomorrow morning.
